Keep the answer you can read, then add a checklist you can use.

## Scenes worth trying

### "Give me a launch checklist I can tick off, with a place for notes."

Reply boost in the chat's three-dot menu now adds an optional A2UI interactive layer after the normal reply has settled. The text answer stays unchanged. The link at the start of the final reply shows generation progress, then becomes "Click to view interactive content". Left-click opens the result in the nm viewer when enabled, otherwise in the system default app; the right-click menu names the same opening method. Interactive results stay in the current conversation workspace.

### "Use this desktop app for me, but ask before each change."

Computer Use can connect to a separately installed external MCP server. It is off by default and exposes only six logical capabilities: list windows, screenshot, click, type, drag and scroll. Window IDs must come from a fresh host-verified list. Observation can be authorized for the session; clicks, typing, dragging and scrolling ask for one-time approval every time, including in Full permission mode. Typed text is hidden from approval cards and audit, and shell, file-management and process-management tools are not exposed.

## Also in this release

- The About page no longer shows the local agents.md path. The file remains editable in the My page.

- Existing plan steps keep their title and acceptance criteria read-only for model tools. Models can update status, notes and evidence only. Evidence pointers must name a successful tool from the current task or a real file inside the session workspace; verified steps cannot rely on model self-description alone.

- A2UI messages are checked against a fixed safe component catalog, with size and component limits, local-only images and no arbitrary HTML, JavaScript, CSS, remote catalog or network access. A2UI content stays out of normal reply copy, export, speech and model history.

## Honest boundaries

- Computer Use requires a compatible external stdio MCP server; WArmy does not bundle or audit that server. Its screenshots can contain private desktop content, so review the authorization scope before enabling it.

- Interactive replies send the question and reply text in a second call to the same provider used for the normal reply. Generation may fail without changing the normal reply. A2UI generation is off by default and does not inherit the old reply-enhancement setting.

- Model output and generated files still need review. Permissions remain per session, and no self-improvement can disable the safety boundaries.

## Install

Download WArmy-Setup-0.4.49.exe from this release and run it. Existing WArmyData carries over. The installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation. The installer SHA-256 is listed in the Checksum section below. First run stops at the language page and waits for you.
